name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP Request to /cxf/Glovia_SalesOrder with valid giic_OrderTypeCode__c matching SalesOrder condition
expected_outcome: HTTP 200/202 Success, message mapped via Test_Mapping, generic headers set in MPL, message ends at EndEvent_2
validates: CallActivity_4 (Set Message headers), ParallelGateway_74, ExclusiveGateway_80 (Route SequenceFlow_82), CallActivity_102 (Test_Mapping), CallActivity_13 (Interface_Generic_Headers), EndEvent_2

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Alternative Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP Request with return order payload matching {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}}
expected_outcome: HTTP 200/202 Success, routes to Return path, bypasses mapping, generic headers set, message ends at EndEvent_9

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation End
trigger: Inbound SOAP Request with unknown order type neither matching SalesOrder nor SOReturn
expected_outcome: SOAP Fault with escalation code RoutingConditionNotMet at EndEvent_11
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default route SequenceFlow_110, EndEvent_11 (EscalationEndEvent with ErrorCode RoutingConditionNotMet)

name: Mapping or Transformation Exception Handling
trigger: Inbound SOAP Request with unparseable payload or schema defect triggering mapping failure
expected_outcome: Execution routed to SubProcess_91, CallActivity_97 enriches body with ${property.InputPayload}, CallActivity_100 logs payload, ends at EndEvent_95

name: Business Order Code Validation Script Verification
expected_outcome: Header OrderCodeValid set to 'true' for valid codes and 'false' for invalid/empty codes without XmlSlurper prefix mismatch
